sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be taken into a raid.
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Unlike the Red Flare Cartridge, this one does not call in an airdrop.
- Firing this flare into the sky will make Scavs, as well as Bosses from the Rogues and Scavs faction in the area friendly until you shoot them. Leaving the area will allow you to be targeted again.
- Firing this flare will illuminate the surrounding area for 20 seconds after ignition

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Cultists
- Dead Scav
- Weapon box (4x4)
- Wooden ammo box
- Wooden crate

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - At the three-story dorms in the "marked room"

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - In the "marked rooms" RB-BK, RB-PKPM and RB-VO

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text:
- In the "marked room" at the abandoned factory
- In the "marked room" at Chekannaya 13

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - This flare was first added as part of Escape from Tarkov's 2022 Halloween celebration
